description:
The Avare aviation GPS app is open on the main map screen. Your task:
1. Tap the 'Find' tab at the bottom of the screen.
2. In the search field, type 'KSFO' (San Francisco International Airport identifier).
3. Tap the search result for KSFO to navigate to it.
4. The map should now be centered on San Francisco International Airport.
5. Verify you can see the airport identifier 'KSFO' or 'San Francisco Intl' on the map or info display.
